card.name: Numbers in contrast-agent dose tables
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before or inside a number in contrast-agent dosing tables (OPTIRAY, OMNIPAQUE), such as 350, 30 to 50 mL, or section numbers. It fires where the next piece is another digit.

modes.label: Inside strengths and volumes
modes.description: A digit or the space before a number in a product strength or mL range, in a dose table.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space after 'to' or a product name, right before the next figure.
modes.example: The recommended dose range per injection is 30 to<< >>50 mL; may repeat as necessary

modes.label: Section references and times
modes.description: The space before a number in a list of section numbers or a time span.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a following digit or number piece; the promoted tokens are otherwise unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before or inside a number in contrast-dye dose tables, where another digit is about to come.
